suppressions.candidate: Session role or active status could be trusted after login
suppressions.note: requireStaff reads the session only for identity and reloads id, email, role and ativo from admin_users on every protected operation; inactive or missing rows are rejected before capability checks.

suppressions.candidate: Secretaria could receive full application or donor records through a direct Server Action call
suppressions.note: The operational actions independently require the capability and select explicit secretary-safe column projections; detailed applications, source documents, decisions, exports and donor management remain behind requireAdmin.

suppressions.candidate: Public upload URL creation could sign an arbitrary storage destination
suppressions.note: The category allowlist and generated UUID constrain every ticket to pending/{uuid}/{approved category}/{sanitized filename}; the upload route verifies the scope-specific HMAC and never accepts a destination from the request body.

suppressions.candidate: Secretaria could download arbitrary historical or ineligible issued documents by id
suppressions.note: The action reloads the issued-document row, re-evaluates the application status and current version set for Secretaria, and only then emits a short-lived download ticket; history remains requireAdmin.

suppressions.candidate: Download endpoint lacks a session check
suppressions.note: The endpoint is deliberately bearer-ticket based. It accepts only an unexpired HMAC ticket with the download scope; tickets are minted by protected actions and responses are private/no-store.
